issue.title: Crash when config file is missing
issue.body: RepoHeart throws an unhandled exception if repoheart.yml is absent.

comment.body:
I can reproduce this on macOS 14 with Python 3.11. The traceback is:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "repoheart/config/loader.py", line 42
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'repoheart.yml'
